criteria.text: Diagnosis of relapsing MS: CIS, RRMS or active SPMS (approval 2)
Patient is 18 years of age or older (approval 1)
Prescribed by or in consultation with a neurologist or provider specializing in MS (approval 3)
CBC and liver function testing completed with results deemed appropriate for treatment (approval 4)
Serum aminotransferase, alkaline phosphatase, and total bilirubin levels documented (approval 5)
Prescriber counseled patients of reproductive potential to use effective contraception during and for 6 months after the last dose (approval 6)
Adequate trial and failure of at least one drug with the same specific indication form of MS (approval 7)
No moderate to severe renal impairment (denial 2)
Patient is not taking dimethyl fumarate (denial 3)

notes: Partial encoding of Alaska Medicaid Vumerity (diroximel fumarate), a fumarate MS DMARD (ms-dmard). Version: 1; Original: 12/9/2019; Approval: 1/17/2020; Effective: 2020-03-16. The source typo fumerate is normalized to diroximel_fumarate.

Encoded: approval criteria 1-7 and denial criteria 1-3; failure to meet approval criteria is handled by approval predicates. Baseline labs, documented liver analytes, counseling and prior treatment are attestations. Counseling is not applicable only for patients not of reproductive potential. Prior therapy must match the specific indication form of MS.

Cautions (notes only): monitor for anaphylaxis and angioedema after the first dosage and throughout treatment; progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML) has occurred with dimethyl fumarate; lymphocyte counts may decrease; liver injury has been reported and should be monitored; avoid alcohol; avoid administration with a high-fat, high-calorie meal or snack.
Duration (notes only): initial approval up to 30 days; reauthorization approval up to 12 months.
Quantity (notes only): 120 × 231mg capsules per month. No numeric quantity enforcement.
PDL status unknown: PDF is silent. Remaining gaps: documentation verification, duration, reauthorization, dosing, quantity enforcement and cautions require manual review.
